subject: [PATCH v3 16/18] selftests/mm: race collapse of windows with holes

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the Linux kernel's selftest suite, specifically targeting the khugepaged functionality. The test is designed to check for potential race conditions when collapsing windows with holes in memory. It runs two types of occupancy tests: one at the fully populated end and another at the hole-heavy end. The test can be run in different modes (stepped, free, madvise) and can be narrowed down to either mode or specifically to the hole-heavy end using the -z option. The patch includes modifications to the khugepaged_race.c file to implement these changes.
